import subprocess, json

FEEDS = [
    'fda_drugs',
    'fda_press_releases',
    'ema_sci_guidelines',
    'ema_reg_guidance',
    'ich_guidelines',
]
all_items = []
feed_errors = []

for feed_id in FEEDS:
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(
            ['python3', '/opt/scripts/rss/fetch_feed.py',
             '--feed-id', feed_id, '--mode', 'live'],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
        )
        if r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip():
            feed_items = json.loads(r.stdout)
            all_items.extend(feed_items)
        elif r.returncode != 0:
            feed_errors.append({'feed_id': feed_id, 'error': r.stderr[:200]})
    except Exception as e:
        feed_errors.append({'feed_id': feed_id, 'error': str(e)})

if not all_items:
    return [{'json': {'_no_items': True, 'feed_errors': feed_errors}}]

return [{'json': item} for item in all_items]

import subprocess, json

item = items[0]['json']

# Skip _no_items sentinel (no new items today)
if item.get('_no_items'):
    return [{'json': item}]

url       = item.get('url', '')
feed_id   = item.get('feed_id', '')
title     = item.get('title', '')
authority = item.get('authority', '')

# Step 1: Resolve landing page -> download PDF or extract HTML text
r1 = subprocess.run(
    ['python3', '/opt/scripts/rss/resolve_landing.py',
     '--url', url,
     '--feed-id', feed_id,
     '--title', title,
     '--authority', authority],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
)
if r1.returncode != 0:
    return [{'json': {
        'status': 'error', 'step': 'resolve',
        'feed_id': feed_id, 'url': url,
        'detail': r1.stderr[:300]
    }}]

resolved = json.loads(r1.stdout)
merged   = {**item, **resolved}

# Step 2: Archive to disk + write metadata.json + register in document_registry
r2 = subprocess.run(
    ['python3', '/opt/scripts/rss/archive.py'],
    input=json.dumps(merged),
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
)
if r2.returncode != 0:
    return [{'json': {
        'status': 'error', 'step': 'archive',
        'feed_id': feed_id, 'url': url,
        'detail': r2.stderr[:300]
    }}]

archived = json.loads(r2.stdout)
doc_id   = archived['doc_id']

# Step 3: Ingest (classify -> chunk -> embed -> index to Qdrant)
r3 = subprocess.run(
    ['python3', '/opt/scripts/ingestion/run_ingest.py',
     '--doc-id', doc_id, '--phase', 'live'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600
)
if r3.returncode != 0:
    return [{'json': {
        'status': 'error', 'step': 'ingest',
        'feed_id': feed_id, 'doc_id': doc_id,
        'detail': r3.stderr[:300]
    }}]

result = json.loads(r3.stdout)

# Already ingested (idempotent)
if result.get('note') == 'already ingested':
    return [{'json': {
        'status': 'skipped',
        'feed_id': feed_id,
        'doc_id': doc_id,
        'title': title[:80],
    }}]

return [{'json': {
    'status':                'ok',
    'feed_id':               feed_id,
    'doc_id':                doc_id,
    'title':                 title[:80],
    'doc_type':              result.get('doc_type', ''),
    'chunk_count':           result.get('chunk_count', 0),
    'classifier_confidence': result.get('classifier_confidence', 0),
    'regulatory_domain':     result.get('regulatory_domain', []),
}}]
